title: PGK1: A Common Biomarker and Therapeutic Target Linking Sarcopenia and Osteoporosis Through Fibroblast-Mediated Pathways.
authors: Zhang, Kun; Li, Hailong; Chen, Xinhong; Tang, Ping; Wang, Meng; Yang, Chunting; Su, Rong; Gao, Xiaqin; Zhang, Fan; Han, Juan
one_liner_zh: 该文通过生物信息学分析筛选肌少症与骨质疏松共病标志物PGK1，涉及转录因子预测但无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Sarcopenia and osteoporosis share pathophysiological links, but their co-occurrence mechanisms remain unclear. This study aimed to identify molecular mediators of their co-development using bioinformatics. Datasets for sarcopenia (GSE56815) and osteoporosis (GSE9103) were retrieved from GEO. Differentially expressed genes (DEGs) were analysed via edgeR and limma. Gene ontology (GO), Kyoto encyclopaedia of genes and genomes (KEGG) and weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA) identified shared pathways and hub genes. Protein-protein interaction (PPI) networks were constructed using STRING and Cytoscape. We validated hub genes in independent datasets (GSE13850, GSE8479) and assessed via ROC curves. Immune infiltration, single-cell analysis and drug prediction were performed. We identified 134 common DEGs (30 upregulated, 104 downregulated). WGCNA and PPI analysis revealed 14 hub genes (APOE, CDK2, PGK1, HRAS, RUNX2 etc.), all with ROC-AUC > 0.6. PGK1 was consistently downregulated in both diseases and linked to 21 miRNAs and six transcription factors (HSF1, TP53, JUN etc.). Single-cell analysis localised PGK1 predominantly in skeletal muscle fibroblasts. DrugBank identified lamivudine as a potential PGK1-targeting therapeutic. PGK1 emerged as a central downregulated gene in sarcopenia and osteoporosis, enriched in fibroblasts and modulated by lamivudine. These findings highlight PGK1 as a shared diagnostic and therapeutic target, offering insights into musculoskeletal crosstalk.
abstract_zh: 肌少症（sarcopenia）与骨质疏松症（osteoporosis）共享病理生理学联系，但其共病机制尚不明确。本研究旨在利用生物信息学方法识别二者共同发展的分子中介因子。从GEO数据库中获取肌少症（GSE56815）和骨质疏松症（GSE9103）的数据集。通过edgeR和limma分析差异表达基因（DEGs）。利用基因本体论（GO）、京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）及加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）识别共享通路和核心基因。使用STRING和Cytoscape构建蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络。我们在独立数据集（GSE13850、GSE8479）中验证核心基因，并通过ROC曲线评估。进行了免疫浸润、单细胞分析和药物预测。我们识别出134个共同DEGs（30个上调，104个下调）。WGCNA和PPI分析揭示了14个核心基因（APOE、CDK2、PGK1、HRAS、RUNX2等），其ROC-AUC均大于0.6。PGK1在两种疾病中均持续下调，并与21个miRNA和六个转录因子（HSF1、TP53、JUN等）相关联。单细胞分析显示PGK1主要定位于骨骼肌成纤维细胞。DrugBank识别出拉米夫定（lamivudine）作为潜在的靶向PGK1的治疗药物。PGK1作为肌少症和骨质疏松症中的核心下调基因，富集于成纤维细胞，并受拉米夫定调节。这些发现突显了PGK1作为共同的诊断和治疗靶点，为肌肉骨骼串扰提供了见解。
